sections.title: Include both swipe & text input options

checks.statement: Size the field to its contents with token-defined minimums. Allow an available-width layout or a fixed size when the enclosing surface calls for it.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured the current Material guidance for this behavior.

evidence.result: Chromium 158.0.8127.18 on local Catalog. 1280×960, standalone Scroll Field Hug/Fill and narrow fixed-width host; 2/3/4 digit examples. The standalone Hug examples stayed content sized with token minimums of 100, 120 and 186 CSS px. Fill expanded to the content width of a 360 CSS px scene.

Firefox 159.0 on local Catalog. 1280×960, standalone Scroll Field Hug/Fill and narrow fixed-width host; 2/3/4 digit examples. The standalone Hug examples stayed content sized with token minimums of 100, 120 and 186 CSS px. Fill expanded to the content width of a 360 CSS px scene.

checks.statement: Provide enabled, hovered, focused and disabled appearances for inactive and active fields.
checks.condition: When rendering the field in either interaction mode.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured the current Material guidance for this behavior.

evidence.result: Chromium 158.0.8127.18 on local Catalog. 1280×960, Show States, Scroll and Text entry specimens. The States view rendered enabled, hovered, focused and disabled examples in both Scroll and Text entry. Computed paint distinguished hover, focus and disabled value opacity.

checks.statement: Keep the current field value and its entry mode legible in high contrast.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured the current Material guidance for this behavior.

evidence.result: Chromium 158.0.8127.18 on local Catalog. 1280×960, standalone Scroll Field in light and dark High contrast, scroll and text entry. Checked visible selected and editable values in the Catalog light and dark High contrast themes. Both modes exceeded 4.5:1 against the track surface.

implementation.notes: Assessed the Catalog High contrast theme in light and dark. Operating-system forced colors were outside this run.

checks.statement: Provide a control near the field for switching to direct entry.
checks.condition: When the field is available for scrolling.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured the current Material guidance for this behavior.

evidence.result: Chromium 158.0.8127.18 on local Catalog. 1280×960, standalone text and numeric Scroll Fields; switch to input, type and submit. The adjacent Switch to text input button opened direct entry for both the numeric Temperature and text Climate mode fields.

checks.statement: Allow swiping in both directions and tapping a neighboring value above or below the selection.
checks.condition: When the scroll mode is active.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured the current Material guidance for this behavior.

evidence.result: Chromium 158.0.8127.18 on local Catalog. Chromium mobile touch emulation at 390×844, finite standalone Scroll Field and Expressive 12-hour modal Scroll; bidirectional drags and both neighbor taps. On a finite standalone field, emulated touch swipes changed the value in both directions and tapping above or below the selected value stepped it in the corresponding direction.

checks.statement: Settle the active choice in the vertical center and distinguish it from neighboring values by size and color.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured the current Material guidance for this behavior.

evidence.result: Chromium 158.0.8127.18 on local Catalog. 1280×960, standalone finite Scroll Field, height slider set to 240 CSS px, pointer taps above and below. On a custom-height finite field, measured the selected line box centered within 1 CSS px, with larger type and a distinct color from its neighbors. Both neighbor pointer clicks changed the selection.

Firefox 159.0 on local Catalog. 1280×960, standalone finite Scroll Field, height slider set to 240 CSS px, pointer taps above and below. On a custom-height finite field, measured the selected line box centered within 1 CSS px, with larger type and a distinct color from its neighbors. Both neighbor pointer clicks changed the selection.

Chromium 158.0.8127.18 on local Catalog. Chromium mobile touch emulation at 390×844, finite standalone Scroll Field and Expressive 12-hour modal Scroll; bidirectional drags and both neighbor taps. After a touch-emulated swipe and release, the selected standalone line box settled within 1 CSS px of the track center.

checks.statement: Allow text entry with a suitable keyboard. Complete string choices from their first character. Show errors below the field and highlight the invalid value.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured the current Material guidance for this behavior.

Numeric and string examples requested their respective keyboard types. Typing h completed Heat, rejected input was highlighted with a message below the field, and valid text committed on Enter.
